tasks.title: Maintenance documentation consistently describes ID-based writes and retained file-window types
tasks.spec: ## Repository: contract — Behavior (Required behavior rules 1-5), Checks 1-8, and Completion evidence. Rewrite the legacy type-table row as file-window and GET /admin/config metadata with a pointer to AdminMaintenanceWindowInput; use database window {id} in the admin write route list; change the 404 meaning to Unknown id. Preserve the schema and validator lists, the detailed database section, valid file-window indices, AdminConfigResponse and AdminWriteResponse meanings, and Markdown table alignment; re-pad affected tables when needed. Edit docs/index.md only.

The retained type row describes the checks-file shape and its file index in GET /admin/config and points write callers to AdminMaintenanceWindowInput. Schema and validator lists, the database section, valid response metadata, and union membership retain their meaning; affected Markdown tables have aligned columns. Independent source: the issue text and Required behavior rules 1-5.
Zero matches; no output; grep exits 1.

Exactly 1 matching route-list line using {id}; AdminMaintenanceView occurs on at least 3 lines, retaining the type row, AdminConfigResponse row and AdminWriteResponse row.
